acceptanceCriteria: Approved Caffeine in-process cache foundation only; no Redis, HTTP response cache, user/session/permission/query/interest cache or raw input persistence. Domain adapters follow in separate PRs.

BOM-managed Caffeine, strict verification, locking, actual license inventory and notices. Bound logical value weights to web16MiB/worker8MiB across named regions; maximum60min expireAfterWrite and no stale-while-refresh.

Read saved small fingerprints every request. Load payload and expected fingerprint in a repeatable-read snapshot, publish only after transaction commits; bypass cache in caller transactions. Coalesce concurrent loads; skip oversized values and failures.

DB stores SHA-256 fingerprints computed on writes transactionally, no source payload. Domain-specific triggers follow separately. PostgreSQL migration/restart/rollback/race and deterministic TTL/size/load tests.
Preserve existing browser work on PR16; no main/develop merge or production deployment. Human commit/push/PR and independent current-head App review.
validationCommands: sh scripts/build/gradle-local.sh --no-daemon check integrationTest bootJar sbom securityCheck

acceptanceCriteria: User explicitly requested that the existing HTTPS skill not be committed. Observe these exact untracked paths only to preserve unrelated work in place. Do not edit, stage, commit, move, delete or ignore them.
Before each commit, push and PR/review operation, verify original SHA-256 and that git ls-files returns no tracked/staged path. They are not performance or server-cache deliverables.
validationCommands: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),c=require("node:crypto"),cp=require("node:child_process");for(const x of [{"file":".agents/skills/https-certificate/SKILL.md","sha256":"47071a68b12a638b0f7c3d3290f92833e955771f854312c2bb14c0074c1b0e0f"},{"file":".agents/skills/https-certificate/agents/openai.yaml","sha256":"7272ebe0da2378a3c3cb769f9c614870091d91d42d13e4ad87d0d6f7d6cde9e7"},{"file":".agents/skills/https-certificate/references/caddy-acme.md","sha256":"540d923e2c305dac16280286bd91fbd23b52a20bafffaf8b51372824483b8335"}]){if(c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(x.file)).digest("hex")!==x.sha256)throw Error("Preserved skill changed: "+x.file);if(cp.execFileSync("git",["ls-files","--",x.file],{encoding:"utf8"}).trim())throw Error("Local skill must remain untracked: "+x.file);}'
